CustomField.description: Site visits with the Completed Visit Status, on leads created during a partner's temporary access and visited within it, that let the partner keep logging in after the access ends. Either this or Exclusive Converted Leads is enough. Blank or 0: visits do not count.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Completed site visits, on leads created during the temporary access, that keep the partner's login after it ends (either this or Exclusive Converted Leads). Blank or 0: not counted.
CustomField.label: Exclusive Site Visits
